sections.heading: Lever
sections.body: A lever trades force and distance about a fulcrum. Ideal mechanical advantage is effort arm over load arm.
sections.visual: Effort and load move opposite the fulcrum. Scrub to see the 3:1 arm ratio in motion.
sections.diagram: <svg viewBox="0 0 800 400" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-label="Lever"><title>Lever</title><rect x="0" y="0" width="800" height="400" rx="16" fill="#101923"/><text x="28" y="35" fill="#e8ecf1" font-size="21" font-family="sans-serif">Lever · effort vs load</text><path d="M28 51 L772 51" fill="none" stroke="#344253" stroke-width="2"/><line class="lw-lever-bar" x1="150" y1="220" x2="650" y2="220" stroke="#7cc7ff" stroke-width="6"/><circle cx="400" cy="220" r="10" fill="#ffd479"/><circle class="lw-lever-effort" cx="180" cy="220" r="14" fill="#7ee2a8"/><circle class="lw-lever-load" cx="580" cy="220" r="18" fill="#b39dff"/><path d="M28 350 L772 350" fill="none" stroke="#344253" stroke-width="2"/><text x="28" y="379" fill="#9aa6b8" font-size="15">Ideal · fulcrum fixed</text></svg>

sections.heading: Wheel and axle
sections.body: A larger wheel turns a smaller axle with a force advantage proportional to the radius ratio.
sections.visual: Wheel and axle rotate together about the same center.
sections.diagram: <svg viewBox="0 0 800 400" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-label="Wheel and axle"><title>Wheel and axle</title><rect x="0" y="0" width="800" height="400" rx="16" fill="#101923"/><text x="28" y="35" fill="#e8ecf1" font-size="21" font-family="sans-serif">Wheel and axle</text><path d="M28 51 L772 51" fill="none" stroke="#344253" stroke-width="2"/><circle class="lw-rotate" cx="400" cy="210" r="90" fill="none" stroke="#7cc7ff" stroke-width="4"/><circle class="lw-rotate" cx="400" cy="210" r="30" fill="#172331" stroke="#ffd479" stroke-width="4"/><path d="M28 350 L772 350" fill="none" stroke="#344253" stroke-width="2"/><text x="28" y="379" fill="#9aa6b8" font-size="15">Same angular speed · different rim force</text></svg>

sections.heading: Pulley
sections.body: A movable pulley can halve the effort for ideal frictionless rope, at the cost of more rope length.
sections.visual: Pull the free end; the load rises half as far as the rope you pull in a simple 2:1 setup.
sections.diagram: <svg viewBox="0 0 800 400" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-label="Pulley"><title>Pulley</title><rect x="0" y="0" width="800" height="400" rx="16" fill="#101923"/><text x="28" y="35" fill="#e8ecf1" font-size="21" font-family="sans-serif">Pulley · 2:1 ideal</text><path d="M28 51 L772 51" fill="none" stroke="#344253" stroke-width="2"/><circle class="lw-pulley-wheel" cx="400" cy="120" r="28" fill="none" stroke="#7cc7ff" stroke-width="4"/><path class="lw-pulley-rope" d="M400 148 L400 260" stroke="#9aa6b8" stroke-width="3"/><rect class="lw-pulley-load" x="375" y="260" width="50" height="40" fill="#b39dff"/><path class="lw-pulley-pull" d="M372 120 L280 200" stroke="#ffd479" stroke-width="3"/><path d="M28 350 L772 350" fill="none" stroke="#344253" stroke-width="2"/><text x="28" y="379" fill="#9aa6b8" font-size="15">Ideal rope · no friction</text></svg>

sections.heading: Inclined plane
sections.body: A gentler ramp reduces required force but increases distance for the same height gain.
sections.visual: Compare steep and gentle ramps: blocks climb as force arrows show the tradeoff.
sections.diagram: <svg viewBox="0 0 800 400" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-label="Inclined plane"><title>Inclined plane</title><rect x="0" y="0" width="800" height="400" rx="16" fill="#101923"/><text x="28" y="35" fill="#e8ecf1" font-size="21" font-family="sans-serif">Gentle vs steep ramp</text><path d="M28 51 L772 51" fill="none" stroke="#344253" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M60 300 L280 140 L280 300 Z" fill="#172331" stroke="#7cc7ff"/><path d="M420 300 L720 140 L720 300 Z" fill="#172331" stroke="#7ee2a8"/><rect class="lw-ramp-block-steep" x="70" y="250" width="36" height="24" fill="#ffd479"/><rect class="lw-ramp-block-gentle" x="400" y="265" width="36" height="24" fill="#ffd479"/><path class="lw-ramp-force-steep" d="M100 240 L140 200" stroke="#b39dff" stroke-width="3"/><path class="lw-ramp-force-gentle" d="M430 250 L500 220" stroke="#b39dff" stroke-width="3"/><path d="M28 350 L772 350" fill="none" stroke="#344253" stroke-width="2"/><text x="28" y="379" fill="#9aa6b8" font-size="15">Same height · different force and distance</text></svg>

sections.heading: Wedge
sections.body: A wedge converts an input force into sideways splitting forces along its faces.
sections.visual: Drive the wedge; side forces push material apart.
sections.diagram: <svg viewBox="0 0 800 400" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-label="Wedge"><title>Wedge</title><rect x="0" y="0" width="800" height="400" rx="16" fill="#101923"/><text x="28" y="35" fill="#e8ecf1" font-size="21" font-family="sans-serif">Wedge · split forces</text><path d="M28 51 L772 51" fill="none" stroke="#344253" stroke-width="2"/><path class="lw-wedge" d="M400 100 L460 280 L340 280 Z" fill="#172331" stroke="#7cc7ff" stroke-width="3"/><path class="lw-wedge-force" d="M400 90 L400 60" stroke="#ffd479" stroke-width="3"/><path class="lw-wedge-left" d="M350 200 L300 200" stroke="#7ee2a8" stroke-width="3"/><path class="lw-wedge-right" d="M450 200 L500 200" stroke="#7ee2a8" stroke-width="3"/><path d="M28 350 L772 350" fill="none" stroke="#344253" stroke-width="2"/><text x="28" y="379" fill="#9aa6b8" font-size="15">Input down · outputs sideways</text></svg>

sections.heading: Screw
sections.body: A screw is a helical inclined plane. One turn advances the screw by one pitch.
sections.visual: The thread is a helical ramp. One full turn advances the screw by one pitch while the handle turns a full circle.
sections.diagram: <svg viewBox="0 0 800 400" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-label="Screw"><title>Screw</title><rect x="0" y="0" width="800" height="400" rx="16" fill="#101923"/><text x="28" y="35" fill="#e8ecf1" font-size="21" font-family="sans-serif">Screw · helix as ramp</text><path d="M28 51 L772 51" fill="none" stroke="#344253" stroke-width="2"/><rect class="lw-screw-body" x="360" y="100" width="80" height="200" rx="8" fill="#172331" stroke="#7cc7ff" stroke-width="3"/><path class="lw-screw-pitch" d="M360 140 Q400 160 440 140 T440 180 T440 220 T440 260" fill="none" stroke="#ffd479" stroke-width="3"/><path d="M28 350 L772 350" fill="none" stroke="#344253" stroke-width="2"/><text x="28" y="379" fill="#9aa6b8" font-size="15">One turn · one pitch of advance</text></svg>
